Sandbox policy ({{.Platform}})
Mode: {{.Mode}} ({{.ModeLabel}})
{{- if .WriteRoots}}
Write roots:
{{- range .WriteRoots}}
- {{.Path}} ({{.Source}})
{{- end}}
{{- else}}
Write roots: none
{{- end}}
Network: {{.Network}}
{{- if .FullAccess}}
Nothing is wider than full access; no escalation applies.
{{- else}}
Escalation: {{.EscalationHint}}
{{- end}}
{{- if eq .Platform "windows"}}
Platform note: paths are case-insensitive; a named pipe or a device path is never writable.
{{- else if eq .Platform "darwin"}}
Platform note: the temporary directories under /private are writable only when they are a write root.
{{- else}}
Platform note: /tmp is writable only when it is a write root.
{{- end}}
